given.note: Sam signs in on a new computer and picks the text route: the page shows a ready text with the code, which he texts from his mobile, since Rosie never texts first (MC C9). A sign-in acts for no person until its code is right, so caller.personId is null (K-22 v1 rule 4); whom the code is for is the account his typed mobile finds on the runtime side (forPersonId person-sam: a sign_in code, K-22 v1 proof_codes.person_id), never anything the browser sends. The code in it is a placeholder.
